notes: Compatibility is an interactive bot or Telegram Mini App service.
Do not publish scheduled compatibility posts into zodiac channel feeds.
Do not create a separate compatibility channel for the MVP.
Fast mode uses signs only. Personal and precise modes collect birth data in memory only.
Unknown birth time is supported and must not block calculation.
Set COMPATIBILITY_BOT_USERNAME only when the bot is created and approved.
COMPATIBILITY_MINI_APP_URL is the public /compatibility HTTPS route used by BotFather Main Mini App.
Set COMPATIBILITY_MINI_APP_NAME and namedDirectLinkMiniAppEnabled=true only if a separate named Direct Link Mini App is explicitly created.
